description: Base image update policy for commercetools Dockerfiles and docker-compose files. Pins images to digests and refreshes those digests as upstream tags are rebuilt (the primary base-image freshness / CVE-remediation win), while routing minor bumps to review and majors to Dependency Dashboard approval so new majors are adopted on a stable release cadence. Automerge is gated by the 🤖 Risk: Low approval from commercetools/renovate-action.

packageRules.description: Digest, pin and patch refreshes: group into one weekly off-hours PR and automerge. A rebuilt tag or patch release is the same version with security fixes, so this is the high-value, low-risk path.
Minor base-image bumps (e.g. node:20.11 -> node:20.12): open a PR for review, light soak, never automerged.

Major base-image / distro bumps are never auto-opened. They wait on the Dependency Dashboard until a human approves, so a new major is adopted on our schedule (maturity / EOL-driven), not on release day.
Node.js follows an LTS cadence: even majors are LTS, odd majors are short-lived. Never allow odd Node majors as candidates; even majors are still gated by the major approval rule above.
